Creating the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Pasig River
Rehabilitation. The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Pasig River Rehabilitation
(OPAPRR) is hereby established under the OP. The OPAPRR shall be headed by the
Presidential Adviser for Pasig River Rehabilitation (PAPRR), appointed by the
President, with the rank and emoluments of a Secretary.

Duties and Functions. The OPAPRR shall oversee and ensure the
efficient, effective, and timely implementation of the rehabilitation and development of
the Pasig River. To this end, the OPAPRR shall:
Advise the President on all matters regarding the formulation and implementation
of policies, plans, activities, and programs of the government towards the
rehabilitation, development, and restoration of the banks and tributaries along the
Pasig River water system and nearby water systems;
Monitor, coordinate, and harmonize all policies, plans, activities, and programs of
the Implementing Agencies in charge of the rehabilitation, development, and
restoration of the banks along the Pasig River water system and nearby water
Coordinate with concerned local government units (LGUs) in the implementation
of policies, plans, activities, and programs related to the Pasig River urban
development, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations;
Monitor the implementation of Presidential directives or priorities for the
rehabilitation, development, and restoration of the banks along the Pasig River
water system and nearby water systems, and coordinate with relevant agencies
in relation thereto;
As may be necessary, call upon any government department, agency, bureau, or
instrumentality, including government-owned or -controlled corporations
(GOCCs), and invite LGUs and representatives from the private sector to provide
assistance in attaining its objectives;
Submit a bi-annual report to the President, through the Office of the Executive
Secretary, on the status of the implementation of this Order; and
g. Perform such other functions as may be directed by the President and/or the
Executive Secretary.

Organizational Structure and Staffing Pattern. The PARR shall
be supported by a staff complement who shall all possess the necessary background
2

and expertise in the field of river rehabilitation. The PAPRR, in coordination with the
Office of the Deputy Executive Secretary for Finance and Administration, shall
determine the appropriate organizational structure, staffing pattern, and corresponding
qualification standards for all positions in OPAPRR, and submit the same for review
and approval of the President and/or the Department of Budget and Management
(DBM), subject to existing laws, rules and regulations, including the Organization and
Staffing Standards and Guidelines issued by DBM and the Civil Service Commission.

Powers and Functions of the IAC-PRUD. The IAC-PRUD shall
continue to perform its duties and functions under Section 2 of EO No. 35. In addition
thereto, the IAC-PRUD, through its member-agencies, shall be authorized to accept
funding by way of entering into investment contracts or agreements with other
government agencies or private entities, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.

Convergence. All concerned government agencies are hereby
directed, and all LGUs and the private sector are hereby encouraged to render full
3

support and cooperation with the OPAPRR to ensure the effective implementation of

Funding. The funding requirements necessary for the
implementation of the Order shall be charged against the respective appropriations of
the concerned agencies and such other funding sources as may be identified by the
DBM. Thereafter, the funding requirements for the continued implementation of this
Order shall be included in the budget proposals of said agencies, subject to the usual
preparation process.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order is held invalid or
unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and

Repeal. EO No. 35 is hereby amended. All other orders, rules and
regulations, and other issuances or parts thereof that are inconsistent with the
provisions of this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 13th day of
Year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Five.
By the President:
